The '''''Nebular Kelpie''''' was a modified [[Lancer-class pursuit craft|''Lancer''-class pursuit craft]] owned by the [[Shungbeek]] [[Kid Malmash]].

==History==
During the [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] between the [[First Order]] and the [[Resistance]], Malmash used the [[starship]] to [[transport]] [[refugee]]s to safe locations.<ref name="TROS VD" />

In [[35 ABY]],<ref name="TROS Date">''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']] to one [[Standard year|year]] after the events of [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']]. As ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the events of ''The Force Awakens'' to [[34 ABY]], the events of ''The Rise of Skywalker'' must occur in [[35 ABY]].</ref> the ''Nebular Kelpie'' part of a [[Citizens' Fleet|fleet]] assembled by [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]] to assist the Resistance during the [[Battle of Exegol|battle]] against the [[Sith Eternal military|Sith Eternal forces]] over the [[planet]] [[Exegol]].<ref name="Episode IX">{{Film|IX}}</ref>
